name: Karleria
source:
Karleria (full name is Karleria Arnas) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Karleria is a snake-like adult yellow-eyed om'verai, ultimately resembling Azaries. Karleria does have 2 spiky head horns, golden belly plates, light triangled mane, cheeck spikes and nose plates.
Karleria is a cold punctual om'verai, caring about good tone. Karleria doesn't respect men for negative experience with her ex. Karleria usually criticizes her son, Karo, believing that he is "useless". Karleria often moves items she holds in her paws.
